title: console: suggestions from the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough: mention and discussion feedback, list selection and bulk results, refusal wording, approvals inbox, dashboards and money formatting, and phone layout
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Suggestions from the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX, track 1 plus the Console-side rows of tracks 2 and 3). Everything was observed at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, with the Console built in-repo from that commit, on stock `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-crm` with `--seed-admin`.

- **Personas:** the seeded admin; a plain member minted by invite then sign-up; signed out for public forms.
- **Viewports:** desktop 1440×900 and phone 390×844.

Each row works today but could be clearer. The reproducible defects from the same pass are their own cards: #27483, #27487, #27491, #27494, #27496, #27498, #27502 (Console); #27504, #27506, #27507, #27509 (Setup); #27511, #27513, #27515, #27517, #27518, #27519 (Studio).

## New suggestions

| # | Observed at c4c515ad (persona, viewport, path) | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Admin, desktop, Projects → Website Relaunch → Discussion. The @mention picker offers a member who cannot read the thread. The comment saves with the mention, the server withholds the notification (`cannot_read_thread`), and the author is told nothing. The rendered mention looks like plain typed text. | Leave such users out of the picker, or tell the author they will not be notified. Render picked mentions as chips. |
| 2 | Member, desktop, same record. The header reads `Discussion (0)` directly above "You don't have permission to view comments on this record." | Omit the count when the comments cannot be read. |
| 3 | Admin, phone, Delivery Operations dashboard. The Total Budget KPI tile cuts its main number to `$1,090,00...`. | Shrink the number to fit, or use compact notation ($1.09M), on a KPI tile's main value. |
| 4 | Admin, desktop, Tasks → Bulk Actions view, 2 of 10 rows selected. The header checkbox is correctly `aria-checked="mixed"`, but it draws a grey check mark. | Draw the mixed state as a dash. |
| 5 | Admin and member, desktop, Tasks. **Reassign…** in the list header is enabled with nothing selected and explains itself only after a click ("This action runs on a single record — select a row first."). The member's grid has no row checkboxes, so for the member it is a dead end. | Disable it with that reason as a tooltip until exactly one row is selected; hide it where rows cannot be selected. |
| 6 | Admin, desktop, Tasks → Grid view inline edit. **Save All** with an empty required Title and an Estimate of -5 is refused in a one-line banner, `Save failed: Title is required and cannot be cleared; Es...`, with the rest only in a native tooltip. The cells are not marked, `min: 0` is not checked before sending, and the button sits flush against the right edge. | Mark the offending cells, check `min` client-side, and show the full message. |
| 7 | Admin, desktop, Tasks list toolbar. A filter row with no value still counts toward the filter badge and persists across reloads. Sort offers "A → Z" for a datetime field and lets the same field be added twice. List search persists across navigation, so a user comes back to "No matching records", and that empty state has no clear button. Studio's list-view sort shows the same "A → Z" for a date. | Ignore incomplete filter rows; use "Oldest → Newest" for dates; refuse duplicate sort fields; add "Clear search" to the empty state. |
| 8 | Admin, desktop, Tasks → bulk **Mark Done** on 2 rows. Done and Progress 100% are set, but Status stays Backlog, so the path still shows Backlog. The result dialog says only `Succeeded 2 / 2`. | Name the records in the result. The Status mismatch may be the showcase action's own definition. |
| 9 | Admin, desktop, task record page. The actions appear twice, in the header and as a button row in the body. The disabled **Archive** tooltip says only `Not available for this record`. | Show one action row; say why Archive is unavailable. |
| 10 | Admin, desktop, delete a task. The confirm dialog does not say the delete cannot be undone. The toast is a generic `Record deleted`, while the create toast names the record. | Say it is permanent (or offer Undo), and name the record in the toast. |
| 11 | Admin, desktop, a draft invoice → **Submit for Sign-off**. The refusal is `Issued On is required`, with no hint to edit the invoice first, and Issued On is not marked required in the edit form. | Say "Fill in Issued On before submitting", and mark fields that are required for submission. |
| 12 | Admin, desktop, Approvals inbox. A row's record link opens the record inside the Account app shell, with no way back to the inbox. **Reject** asks for no reason. The admin may decide a request they submitted themselves. | Open the record in the inbox's own app, or keep a back link; offer an optional reason on Reject; consider showing "you submitted this" on self-submitted requests. |
| 13 | Admin, desktop, bell. The header says `4 total · 1 notification + 3 pending approvals`, while the single collapsed row reads `×3 … 3 unread` and shows only the first record's text. | Make the header and the row counts agree; expand a grouped row to list its records. |
| 14 | Admin, desktop, project record page. Dates are formatted two ways on one page (`Dec 28, 2026` / `Sep 29`). The Attachments card is wider than the others, and comment text is low-contrast grey. | One date format per page; align the card widths; raise the comment text contrast. |
| 15 | Admin, desktop and phone, CRM Pipeline dashboard. The comparison series uses the same blue swatch as the main series. The stage chart's legend has no swatches. The month axis shows raw `2025-10`. KPI money values carry no currency. The CRM widget descriptions themselves leak authoring notes ("Pie/donut/funnel ignore `compareTo`"); those are example content. | A distinct swatch for the comparison series; legends with swatches; format month buckets ("Oct 2025"); format KPI money with the field's currency. |
| 16 | Admin, desktop, CRM Opportunities. Two adjacent money columns are formatted differently, `35,000.00` and `35,000`. | One currency format per column type. |
| 17 | Admin, desktop, an empty list (a new object with no records). The empty state offers no **New** button. | Offer Create in the empty state when the user may create. |
| 18 | Admin, phone, Tasks list and Home. The floating "+" overlaps a card's priority badge. On Home, the header links beside "Your apps" wrap awkwardly. Horizontal bar chart labels are cut to "In Progr…". | Reserve space for the FAB; let the header links scroll; wrap or abbreviate bar labels with a tooltip. |
| 19 | Admin, desktop, the runtime create form of a Studio-authored object whose validation rule refuses the save. The refusal shows twice, as a banner and an identical toast, and the violating field is not marked. | One message, and mark the field the rule names. |
| 20 | Member, desktop, a list the member cannot read. The no-access state offers **Retry**, which cannot help. On an invoice the member can read, the Line Items section shows a red "You do not have permission to perform this action." although the member did nothing. | Drop Retry on a permission refusal; draw an unreadable related list as a quiet "No access" line. |
| 21 | Admin, desktop, every object list toolbar (also on Studio-authored objects). An **In a queue** toggle has no tooltip, and its meaning is unclear to a new user. | A tooltip, or show it only on objects that use queues. |

## Already carded: not raised again

| Observation at c4c515ad | Card |
|---|---|
| Public form unbranded, blue Submit, tab titled "ObjectOS": still reproduces | #27355 row 9 |
| A refused public-form submit does not mark the fields: still reproduces (the stale "Required:" banner is #27496) | #27355 row 10 |
| A Backlog task's path tints "Done" as a later step: still reproduces | #26612, #26694 |
| The approval request page's `RECORD ID` holds a name: still reproduces | #27356 row 7 |
| Phone: Setup Users and Invitations show no Invite, Create or Import (the buttons are in the DOM at 0×0), so no user can be invited from a phone | #27058 (phone list with a FAB) |
| A member at `/apps/setup/system/settings` sees "No settings registered …" | #27507 (filed from this pass) |

Rows of #27355 that no longer reproduce at this sha: row 5 (the task record's ⋯ menu now has Delete), row 6 (a member's double-click in Grid opens the record instead of editing), row 11 (phone KPI tiles are two per row; row 3 above is a new truncation).

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, with its own card if it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.
